doc: T3794: in a capture build (TSFP_BUILD_CAPTURE=1) the lifted original of every src/game registration runs instead of the hand-written replacement, so its call gets a capture frame (tools/t2capture/game_originals.py). Registrations from the sources listed here keep their replacement: they carry a host duty the lifted body cannot do on its own.

keep_replacement_sources.codewrite_roots.inc: code-write transaction and SMC host duty (T1818), registered from codewrite_roots.c
keep_replacement_sources.codewrite_tx_roots.inc: code-write transaction and SMC host duty (T1818), registered from codewrite_tx_roots.c
keep_replacement_sources.rust_ext_roots.c: Rust ext root adapters run retained originals already (rust-ext-originals-all, transformed in capture builds)
